name: Fragmented Burst
body:
You can use your fragmented step ability without moving.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, shattersoul, fragmented step species trait, Combat Expertise, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): You can use your fragmented step ability one additional time per day. As a full-round action, you can expend one use of fragmented step to send out shards of your body at every creature within a 30-foot radius, dealing damage as per your fragmented step ability. If you have the fragmented charge ability, you can instead choose to affect every creature in a 60-foot radius.
